tagline: The Ladybird browser for Xios desktop sessions
description:
[Ladybird](https://ladybird.org) is a new web browser with its own engine, written from scratch rather than built on WebKit or Chromium. This is the desktop build, which runs as a window inside a Xios desktop session.

It adds a normal application entry and opens through whichever desktop you are running.

If you want a home-screen browser icon instead, install **Ladybird** (`ladybird-app`).
